test: example-placement: full rubric with Examples blocks removed, examples shuffled into a pool, judge must return each to its level
metric: per-example count of judges (0-3) recovering the true level
masking: explicit 'at Level N' cross-references inside example text rewritten to 'at the level below' so they do not leak the answer

PLp: Decide the order in which to run three independent errands
three independent errands read as a decomposition into a few independent subtasks, which is L2's own condition
Build a personal webpage using a template
using a template reads as a single retrieved routine
expedition planning has established procedures, so the decomposition is not obviously undiscoverable
PLe: Type a query into a search engine and read the first result
two acts (type, read) read as a short checked sequence rather than one atomic action
PLs: Explore an unfamiliar codebase to establish where a behaviour is implemented
locating where a behaviour lives reads as inference from evidence, colliding with the L3 debugging item
MSc: Turn down a colleague's invitation to join their project
declining moves the other party off a position they hold, which is L3
Agree a price with a market trader
haggling reads as opposed interests, which is L4

predicted_clean: all Level 5 items in all four dimensions; PLe ledger (L4); PLs debug (L3); MSc shouting-customer refund (L4); PLp Darwin publication-year (L0)
decision_rule: any example scoring <=1/3 is rewritten; 2/3 is reviewed and rewritten only if the two disagreeing judges land on the same wrong level
